notes.title: Leaving Early Access in 2025
notes.content:
Dear Survivors!

I am excited to announce that Escape Z is about to reach a major milestone. With the next update, the game will officially exit from Early Access, an event scheduled for 2025.

After months of development, I am ready to launch the full version of the game. This update will introduce new features, improvements and extra content to provide an even more polished and immersive experience.

With the official release, the price of the game will be tweaked slightly to reflect the work done and content added. Those who have already purchased the game will continue to receive all future updates at no additional cost.

Thank you for supporting Escape Z throughout the Early Access journey. I look forward to sharing with you all the new features that will come with the next update! 🚀

notes.title: Update on languages Escape Z
notes.content:
In the next update, I am excited to announce the addition of three new languages to Escape Z:  Chinese, Dutch, and Greek. This represents the final step in my efforts to make the game accessible to a global audience.

Why these languages?
I chose these languages based on community feedback and the goal of including regions of the world that are still underrepresented in the game. Each new translation has been carefully edited to ensure consistency and quality, with the support of experienced, native-speaking translators.

Latest round of translations
With the addition of these languages, my work on internationalizing the game is officially complete. Escape Z now supports a wide range of languages covering multiple geographic areas, providing an increasingly inclusive experience.

A thank you to the community
I could not have achieved this goal without your support and suggestions. Your passion has guided me every step of the way, and I am happy to have made Escape Z even more welcoming to players around the world.

Keep following me for more news: as I finish work on translations, new content and features are already under development. Stay tuned!

All the changes listed below are designed to balance gameplay and provide a more immersive experience by enhancing the unique characteristics of each weapon.

✅ Striker-12:

 Increased maximum damage from 250 to 270, improving effectiveness in close combat.
 Increased reload time from 1.5 to 2 seconds, to balance the increased power.
 Increased the maximum vertical recoil from 0.5 to 0.9, making weapon control more challenging.
 Changed the reloading mode to improve the smoothness and realism of the animation.


✅ SR S96:

 Increased maximum damage from 550 to 700, providing devastating impact at long distances.
 Increased maximum ammunition from 15 to 20, providing greater range in combat.


✅ SCAR-H:

 Increased maximum damage from 90 to 110, improving its effectiveness in mid-range situations.


✅ Grenade launcher:

 Increased maximum damage from 600 to 800, to strengthen its role as a heavy area weapon.


✅ M890:

 Reduced maximum damage from 1000 to 650, for better balance compared to other weapons of similar category.


✅ M4A1:

 Reduced maximum damage from 200 to 180, to fit its role as a versatile weapon.
 Modified recoil, improving control and accuracy in extended shots.


Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: New Map Update - The Castle
notes.content:
Dear Survivors,

I am excited to share some great news with you: I am working on a new map, and I am happy to present it to you - welcome to the "Castle"!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44562314/a1667d8f2039823eb615a40ec2d4125cf79d49e1.png
Medieval Inspiration:
The decision to create a map set in a castle was fuelled by a passion for the medieval and mysterious atmosphere. I tried to capture the essence of an ancient fortress, full of secrets and challenges.


Next Steps:
As I work hard on this map, I want to assure you that I will keep the community updated on any progress. I hope to implement the "Castle" in the next update, and I look forward to seeing how you find yourself in this new environment.


Abandoned City Map Removal?
I am considering the removal of the Abandoned City map due to the fact that it is too large, compromising the pace of play and cohesion of the action. As well as the unbalanced nature of such a map. notes.title: Development of Version 0.1
notes.content:
Dear Survivors,

I wanted to share with you the excitement surrounding the development of the upcoming Version 0.1 of Escape Z. My commitment is to make this game experience even more immersive and enriching, and there are some new features that I am looking forward to introducing:

New Features; Activatable Traps:
I am working hard to introduce a completely new tactical element-activatable traps. This will allow you to activate strategic traps to escape zombies more intelligently. Whether it's fire traps that burn zombies or electrical devices that disorient them, I want to provide you with new tools to deal with the apocalypse.

Support for Portuguese:
I have listened to your requests and am excited to announce the addition of full Portuguese language support. Now you can experience the zombie adventure with an accurate and engaging translation in your native language.

Interactions and Feedback:
Your feedback has always been crucial. During the development of this version, I am taking your suggestions and requests into account. I want "Escape Z" to be an experience that reflects your expectations and wishes.

Community Involvement:
I will continue to involve you through social channels and game forums. Please share your ideas and experiences. Your participation is critical to the growth and evolution of the game.

Thank you for being part of this adventure with me. Version 0.1 is an exciting step forward, and I look forward to sharing it with you. And I take this opportunity to wish you all a happy holiday season!

notes.title: Roadmap Development
notes.content:
Dear Survivors,

Today I want to give you a behind-the-scenes look into the creative process of my update roadmap. I recently adopted Trello as my main bulletin board to keep you updated on upcoming "Escape Z" news.

CLICK HERE TO SEE ROADMAP


Structuring on Trello
Once the main goals were defined, I organized them on Trello. I created columns for the different stages of development, from "Things to Do" to "In Development," "Bugs," and finally to "Ideas." This structure allows me to easily track the status of each feature.

Details and Assignments
Each card on Trello represents a specific feature or improvement. I have added clear details about what each feature entails.

Community Feedback
A special section on Trello is dedicated to community feedback. I gather your opinions from social media, forums, and surveys and integrate them directly into the roadmap. I want you to be an integral part of the decisions made.

Regular Updates
I want to commit to keeping you constantly informed. Each week, I post updates on the bulletin board on Trello to let you know what I am working on and what you can expect in upcoming updates.



The Future in Evolution
The creation of this roadmap on Trello is just the beginning. I want "Escape Z" to grow with you, responding to your needs and aspirations. I will continue to update the board and involve you in building the future of the game.

Thank you for being part of this development adventure. I look forward to seeing what you think and to giving you an increasingly immersive game experience.

The "Escape Z" team.

In this first version, you will immerse yourself in the zombie apocalypse and experience the basic mechanics of the game. You will fight hordes of zombies, explore a post-apocalyptic world, and get to know key characters. This will be a small preview of the world I am creating.

I look forward to sharing this first version of "Escape Z" with all of you. November 6 is just around the corner, and together we will face the zombie hordes and the apocalypse.
